title: 航空黏接接頭驗證
summary: 以航空黏接的原創搭接試片，學習平均剪力、端部剝離、表面污染、固化與環境影響；不把任何算例當黏膠允許值。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use original aerospace bonding coupons to study mean shear, end peel, surface contamination, cure and environment without treating examples as adhesive allowables. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 搭接平均剪應力：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Average lap-joint shear: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 搭接平均剪應力 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Average lap-joint shear and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 搭接平均剪應力可作負載帳，但端部剝離、表面處理與環境老化往往控制失效。
steps.instructionEn: Average lap-bond shear provides a load balance, while end peel, surface preparation and aging often control failure.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空黏接接頭驗證實際性能或製程：F=5000 N，寬b=25 mm，長l=50 mm。式 τavg=F/(bl)，基準結果 4 MPa。適用條件：均勻剪應力假設，非黏膠強度或航空接合資格。 應力若以Pa算出，除10⁶轉MPa；N/mm²已等於MPa。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aircraft bonded-joint verification: F=5000 N, width b=25 mm and overlap l=50 mm. Formula τavg=F/(bl) gives 4 MPa. Conditions: Uniform-shear assumption, not adhesive strength or bond qualification. Divide pascals by 10^6 for MPa; N/mm² already equals MPa.
steps.failure: 同樣平均應力下，污染界面可能先失效；不能由長搭接推論等比例強度。
steps.failureEn: A contaminated interface may fail first at equal average stress; longer overlap need not increase strength proportionally.
steps.check: 比較短搭接與長搭接的端部變形，保留破壞面照片分類而非只記峰值力。
steps.checkEn: Compare end deformation of short/long laps and classify failure-surface images rather than recording peak load alone.

knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把l改成60 mm；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 4 改為 3.33333333 MPa。在算式區重算並記下對「搭接平均剪應力」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。

Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Average lap-joint shear, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

steps.title: 偏心引起的剝離趨勢：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Peel tendency from eccentricity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 偏心引起的剝離趨勢 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Peel tendency from eccentricity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 分布升力經翼盒傳到翼根；相同總力若作用中心更外移，根部彎矩也會增加。
steps.instructionEn: Distributed lift passes through the wing box to the root; moving the centre of force outward increases root moment even at equal total force.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空黏接接頭驗證實際性能或製程：等效半翼力F=5000 N，力臂a=2 m。式 M=Fa，基準結果 10000 N·m。適用條件：單一靜態等效力，未包括燃油、引擎與動態慣性分布。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aircraft bonded-joint verification: Equivalent half-wing force F=5000 N and arm a=2 m. Formula M=Fa gives 10000 N·m. Conditions: One equivalent static force, excluding distributed fuel, engine and dynamic inertia effects.
steps.failure: 忽略向下的設備重量或錯誤力臂，會使根部彎矩與測值不合。
steps.failureEn: Omitted downward equipment weight or a wrong arm causes disagreement with measured root moment.
steps.check: 沿翼展標出每一載荷方向，分段累積剪力與彎矩並核對根部平衡。
steps.checkEn: Mark load directions along the span, accumulate shear and moment by segment, and check root equilibrium.
